about: 人的正常关节活动范围（度），从解剖中立位量起，给 .blend 控制骨的旋转限制用（DECISIONS 绑定与动作的“关节极限”）。value 是取整后的默认值，取自 source；detail 是来源里的原始数；null 是还没有能读到的来源。说明和换到骨骼局部轴的方法见 range-of-motion.md。

soucie2011.citation: Soucie JM, Wang C, Forsyth A, et al. Range of motion measurements: reference values and a database for comparison studies. Haemophilia 2011;17(3):500-507.
soucie2011.population: 674 healthy, 2-69 y, US; nine physical therapists, universal goniometer, passive (per the paper's abstract); the CDC page gives value and 95% CI by sex and age group

mckay2017.citation: McKay MJ, Baldwin JN, Ferreira P, et al. Normative reference values for strength and flexibility of 1,000 children and adults. Neurology 2017;88(1):36-43.
mckay2017.population: 1000 healthy, 3-101 y, Sydney; active ROM, goniometer or inclinometer; mean (SD) by age group and sex

roaas1982.citation: Roaas A, Andersson GBJ. Normal range of motion of the hip, knee and ankle joints in male subjects, 30-40 years of age. Acta Orthop Scand 1982;53(2):205-208.
roaas1982.population: 105 healthy men, 30-40 y, Göteborg; passive, AAOS technique; hip extension and rotation prone with knee flexed, abduction and adduction supine with knee extended. Table 1 also lists the AAOS handbook values and Boone & Azen (1979)

gill2020.citation: Gill TK, Shanahan EM, Tucker GR, Buchbinder R, Hill CL. Shoulder range of movement in the general population: age and gender stratified normative data using a community-based cohort. BMC Musculoskelet Disord 2020;21:676.
gill2020.population: 2404, 20-91 y (mean 45.8), Adelaide; active, inclinometer; right side means over all ages

fan2018.citation: Fan S, Cepek J, Symonette C, et al. Variation of grip strength and wrist range of motion with forearm rotation in healthy young volunteers aged 23 to 30. J Hand Microsurg 2019;11(2):88-93.
fan2018.population: 30 healthy, 23-30 y; goniometer; values depend on forearm rotation

ibrahim2024.citation: Mohamed Ibrahim BK, Baba PUF, Singh V, et al. The normal active range of motion of the index, middle, ring, and little fingers in a sample of Indian population. Indian J Plast Surg 2024;57(4):248-255.
ibrahim2024.population: 390 hands, four centres, India; active, goniometer; mean (SD) per finger

ferrario2002.citation: Ferrario VF, Sforza C, Serrao G, Grassi G, Mossi E. Active range of motion of the head and cervical spine: a three-dimensional investigation in healthy young adults. J Orthop Res 2002;20(1):122-129.
ferrario2002.population: 30 women, 30 men, young adults; optoelectronic; head-cervical total arcs (both directions together)

troke2005.citation: Troke M, Moore AP, Maillardet FJ, Cheek E. A normative database of lumbar spine ranges of motion. Man Ther 2005;10(3):198-206.
troke2005.population: 405 asymptomatic, 16-90 y; standing, CA6000 spine motion analyser; lumbar only, ranges given from youngest to oldest

gates2016.citation: Gates DH, Walters LS, Cowley J, Wilken JM, Resnik L. Range of motion requirements for upper-limb activities of daily living. Am J Occup Ther 2016;70(1):7001350010p1-p10.
gates2016.population: 15 right-handed healthy; motion capture during eight daily activities; these are the motions needed, not the maximum

konor2012.citation: Konor MM, Morton S, Eckerson JM, Grindstaff TL. Reliability of three measures of ankle dorsiflexion range of motion. Int J Sports Phys Ther 2012;7(3):279-287.
konor2012.population: 20 healthy, 24 +- 3 y; weight-bearing lunge, heel down, knee to the wall over the second toe; tibia's angle from vertical by digital inclinometer at the tibial tuberosity and by goniometer along the fibula, zeroed with the tibia vertical

fujimori2012.citation: Fujimori T, Iwasaki M, Nagamoto Y, et al. Kinematics of the thoracic spine in trunk rotation: in vivo 3-dimensional analysis. Spine 2012;37(21):E1318-E1328.
fujimori2012.population: 13 healthy volunteers; CT in neutral and maximum trunk rotation to each side, voxel-based registration; T1 relative to L1 and each segment

fujimori2014.citation: Fujimori T, Iwasaki M, Nagamoto Y, et al. Kinematics of the thoracic spine in trunk lateral bending: in vivo three-dimensional analysis. Spine J 2014;14(9):1991-1999.
fujimori2014.population: 15 healthy men; CT supine in neutral and maximum lateral bending to each side; T1 relative to L1 and each segment

morita2014.citation: Morita D, Yukawa Y, Nakashima H, et al. Range of motion of thoracic spine in sagittal plane. Eur Spine J 2014;23(3):673-678.
morita2014.population: 50 patients with cervical or lumbar disease but no thoracic disease, 27-81 y (mean 55); CT at passive maximum flexion and extension, no neutral scan

krohn2020.citation: Krohn S, Frahm J, Mahler A, et al. Biomechanical analysis of temporomandibular joint dynamics based on real-time magnetic resonance imaging. Int J Comput Dent 2020;23(3):235-244.
krohn2020.population: healthy volunteers, real-time MRI at 15 frames per second; mean mandibular rotation and horizontal condylar inclination

li2016.citation: Li XY, Jia C, Zhang ZC. The normal range of maximum mouth opening and its correlation with height or weight in the young adult Chinese population. J Dent Sci 12(1):56-59.
li2016.population: 452 healthy, 20-35 y, China; maximum interincisal opening

gallagher2004.citation: Gallagher C, Gallagher V, Whelton H, Cronin M. The normal range of mouth opening in an Irish population. J Oral Rehabil 2004;31(2):110-116.
gallagher2004.population: 1513 adults, 16-99 y, Irish national survey; maximum mouth opening falls with age

skaricic2020.citation: Škaričić J, Čimić S, Kraljević-Šimunković S, Vuletić M, Dulčić N. Influence of occlusal splint on mandibular movements in patients with bruxism: a comparative pilot study. Acta Stomatol Croat 2020;54(3):322-332.
skaricic2020.population: 9 adults with bruxism, mean 28.7 y, ultrasonic face bow; laterotrusion at the incisal point, before treatment. A pilot study of patients, used only for the size of the movement; the text also quotes Agerberg's 5 mm as the normal floor

gerling.citation: Gerling J, Lieb B, Kommerell G. Duction ranges in normal probands and patients with Graves' ophthalmopathy, determined using the Goldmann perimeter. Int Ophthalmol 21(4):213-221.
gerling.population: 100 normal probands, 21-70 y, one eye; Goldmann perimeter, the end point of a slow pursuit

flexion.note: 前屈上举，含肩胛的参与。被动。

abduction.note: 侧举上举，含肩胛的参与。主动，20–91 岁的平均，年轻人更大：从最年轻到最年长组下降约 37–40°。

internalRotation.note: 主动；文中没读到测量体位。

externalRotation.note: 主动；文中没读到测量体位。

hyperextension.note: 伸直以外的过伸，女性更多。

pronation.note: 从拇指朝上的中立位量。

supination.note: 从拇指朝上的中立位量。

flexion.note: 前臂中立位：男 70.2–72.6，女 79.9；随前臂旋转变化，旋后时男性只有约 63。摘要里的数是分散的，取约数。

extension.note: 男性旋后 64.6、旋前 69.5；女性各位置无显著差别（摘要没给数）。

ulnarDeviation.note: 女性非利手旋前 33.2、旋后 44.6；男性不随前臂位置变化（摘要没给数）。

extension.note: 取 CDC 20–44 岁被动的平均（女 18.1、男 17.4），和其他关节一样取成人被动值；原来写 15，偏紧。Roaas 俯卧屈膝只有 9.4；AAOS 手册 28。

abduction.note: 仰卧伸膝。AAOS 手册 48，Boone & Azen 40.5。

internalRotation.note: 俯卧屈膝。McKay 主动 36–40。AAOS 手册 35，Boone & Azen 44.4。

externalRotation.note: 俯卧屈膝。McKay 主动 27–30。AAOS 手册 48，Boone & Azen 44.2。

dorsiflexion.note: 屈膝、负重（弓步，足跟着地）时胫骨离竖直的角度，两次测量、两侧；取更可靠的倾角计 38–40。伸膝时被动只有 13–18（CDC、Roaas、AAOS），差别来自跨膝的腓肠肌：伸膝时它先拉紧，屈膝时放松，屈膝的值才是踝本身能转多少。控制骨的极限不知道膝角，取伸膝的值会挡住所有下蹲，所以取屈膝负重的值。McKay 主动 29–32 也在两者之间。论文引用的正常范围是 30–50。

plantarflexion.note: 被动，CDC 55–62；Roaas 39.7；AAOS 手册 48；McKay 主动 56–62。

eversion.note: 外翻（valgus），前足加后足。AAOS 手册前足 18 加后足 5，Boone & Azen 19.2。

inversion.note: 内翻（varus），前足加后足。AAOS 手册前足 33 加后足 5，Boone & Azen 36.2。

flexion.note: 主动，成人 56–59。Ferrario 头颈屈伸合计 130（男）、136（女）。

lateralFlexion.note: 每侧。左右合计男 77、女 91，按对称取一半。

rotation.note: 每侧。左右合计男 155、女 162，按对称取一半。

flexion.note: 只是腰椎。从最年轻到最年长组 73 → 40。

rotation.note: 每侧，各年龄中位数都约 7；胸椎的扭转另算，这里没有来源。
每侧，T1 对 L1。各节之和 21.4，小于整段直接量的 24.9（耦合的侧屈、屈伸也在里面）。中段（T6–T11）最大。

lateralFlexion.note: 每侧，仰卧，T1 对 L1。各节之和 17.8，大于整段的 15.6。下段（T10–L1）最大。

flexionExtensionArc.note: 屈到伸的总弧，被动，CT。没有中立位的扫描，所以分不出屈多少、伸多少；最大一节在 T12/L1（4.2），最小在 T4/5（0.9）。患者组，平均 55 岁。

opening.note: 下颌绕横轴的转动，到最大张口，取整。前滑不算在角度里。切牙间距 52 ± 5 mm（男 54、女 50，li2016）；全人群调查男 43、女 41，随年龄变小（gallagher2004）。

lateralExcursion.note: 每侧。来源量的是切牙点的侧移，约 8 mm，不是角度；按关节到切牙约 95 mm 换成约 5°，这个杠杆是估的，没有来源。绕竖轴的近似。

functional.note: 八项日常上肢动作需要的范围，不是最大值；可作为干净范围的下限目标。负号在前的是相反方向。
